data.title: 苍崎青子 · 旅馆温汤后的微醺长谈
data.description: 日式旅馆温暖的榻榻米房间内，青子身穿宽松针织衫与短裤，未干的栗红长发披散在肩头，脸颊泛着淡淡红晕，目光专注而柔软。
data.action: sitting on tatami, relaxed sweater, flushed cheeks, tender close gaze
data.lighting: intimate golden lantern light casting gentle shadows
data.promptProse: In a quiet traditional inn room illuminated by soft amber lantern glow, Aozaki Aoko relaxes in a cozy knit top, her hair framing delicately flushed cheeks.
data.animaCaption: Aoko looking tenderly with flushed cheeks in a quiet lantern-lit room.
